name: Beijing Urban Construction Investment & Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Urban Construction Investment & Development Co., Ltd. specializes in property development across several major Chinese cities, including Beijing, Tianjin, Chongqing, Chengdu, Qingdao, and Sanya. The company's projects encompass a wide range of real estate, from residential offerings like homes, apartments, and villas, to commercial ventures such as retail centers, hotels, and corporate office buildings. This firm was established in 1998 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
